observations.fit: ordinary least squares of ln(V/1 V) against ln(d/1 cm), one global calibration fitted only to the five experimental LED pairs
observations.label_curve: A*(d/1 cm)**(-gamma), positive distances; no artificial endpoint anchors and no target clipping
observations.out_of_range_policy: Retain positive query distances; identify extrapolated labels and separately report interval/extrapolation subsets. Applies to every model, without selection on results.
observations.empirical_feature: negative centered finite-difference derivative, half-step 0.05 cm, same fitted power law; no slope clipping required at retained queries
observations.source: Figure 3 and author confirmation; observed manual activation distances, color-estimated threshold voltages, LED legs separated by 2 cm

interpretation: LED-equivalent surrogate voltage; not an independently measured potential relative to ground.
